scenes.summary: A quiet morning ritual at a coffee shop takes a gentle turn when a stranger returns something Anna didn't know she'd dropped.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: A soft wool sweater in oatmeal tone, simple silver earrings.
Dark denim apron over a white t-shirt; hair tied back.
Slim charcoal wool coat over a collared shirt.

must_keep_scene_facts: Warm golden morning light through the front window.
Anna's cup is on the counter, not a table.

environment_notes: Neighborhood coffee shop interior at 8am, warm morning light rakes in through the front window.
Counter is reclaimed wood; copper espresso machine on the back bar; handful of patrons quietly chatting in soft focus background.

identity_notes: Anna, early 30s, quiet confidence, light skin, shoulder-length chestnut hair, warm brown eyes.
wardrobe_notes: Oatmeal-tone wool sweater, silver stud earrings.

identity_notes: Mira, the barista, mid-20s, easy smile, medium skin, dark hair pulled back in a low pony.
wardrobe_notes: Dark denim apron over a plain white tee.

identity_notes: A stranger, late 30s, kind eyes, short dark hair, slight winter tan; understated warmth.
wardrobe_notes: Charcoal wool coat, collared shirt, no scarf.

global_style_notes: Cinematic 35mm look: warm golden morning light, shallow depth of field, soft film grain.
Palette: oatmeal, copper, cream, charcoal. Minimal cool tones.
must_avoid: Flat fluorescent lighting, saturated neon colors, hand-held shake.

scene_end.turn: An ordinary order becomes a small moment of connection.

shots.text: Wide interior of the coffee shop at sunrise. Mira slides a steaming ceramic cup across the reclaimed-wood counter toward Anna, who is cupping her hands around her phone. Golden light rakes across the counter.

camera.framing_notes: Hold Anna and the cup on the counter; background patrons soft-focus.

shots.visual_goal: Establish Anna's calm morning ritual; plant the cup and Anna's right hand on the counter.
shots.action_focus: Mira slides cup toward Anna; Anna looks up from her phone.

keyframe_notes: Cup mid-slide, Anna's eyes lifting toward Mira.

camera.framing_notes: Over Anna's shoulder toward Mira; cup warm in foreground.

shots.visual_goal: Anchor Anna's voice and quiet warmth; register Mira's small nod in reply.
shots.action_focus: Anna speaks over the rim of the cup; Mira nods back, smiling.

keyframe_notes: Anna mid-word; steam in the foreground softens the frame.

shots.text: Close-up of the counter. A charcoal-coated stranger's hand slides a small folded cream paper note across the wood, stopping just beside Anna's cup. The note's hand-torn edge catches the light.

camera.framing_notes: Top-down / near-top-down on the counter; cup on the right, note entering from left.

shots.visual_goal: Introduce the note and the stranger without revealing his face; rhyme the fold crease with the rising steam.
shots.action_focus: A man's hand places a folded cream note next to the cup.

keyframe_notes: Note half-placed on the counter; hand still in frame; fingers beginning to lift.

camera.framing_notes: Two-shot profile; Anna right-of-frame looks up, Stranger left-of-frame half-turned.

shots.visual_goal: Pay off the mystery: Anna sees the stranger; a small smile of curiosity forms as she picks up the note.
shots.action_focus: Stranger speaks and steps back half a pace; Anna unfolds the note and the corners of her mouth lift.

keyframe_notes: Anna lifting the note open; stranger mid-word, already turning away.
